description: Unit-start and repeat-region probes on ESM++ layer 35 for the start-trim unit placement: helix-rich extents decode units from attention stacking plus a unit-start boundary term; strand-rich extents keep the phase-SSM decode; both then drop end units whose mean repeat-region score is below a threshold.

fit.model: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression (C 0.01, balanced classes) folded into one linear map
fit.training_set: RepeatsDB class 3 development_draft.v1 (2,286 records), layer-35 hidden-state cache
fit.unit_start: residues inside curated regions with >= 3 units; label 1 at a curated unit start; 200,000 sampled rows
fit.repeat_region: all residues; label 1 inside a curated region with >= 3 units; 300,000 sampled rows

validation.selection: all 2,285 called development records; nested dev estimate vs v0.2.0: boundary F1 +0.086 [+0.063, +0.107], matched-unit IoU +0.018 [+0.005, +0.030]
validation.test_draft: 571 proteins, predeclaration sha256 d1fa748c11c1c163dd6cad7bedcee21db677c9bb830d37bbeea53415d9b0034a: boundary F1 0.548 -> 0.601, +0.053 [+0.021, +0.083]; matched-unit IoU +0.011 [-0.008, +0.029]; unit-count error 2.56 -> 1.42; CONFIRMED
validation.fresh_holdout_v1: 597 proteins, predeclaration sha256 02806a8e314ec1b89f5bf5779f50a363ff9e780fc73a30ae3abe85d2c3ea48d8: boundary F1 0.425 -> 0.451, +0.026 [+0.005, +0.048]; matched-unit IoU -0.003 [-0.018, +0.012]; unit-count error 5.63 -> 4.02; NOT CONFIRMED (IoU non-inferiority guard)

credits: Unit-start/region probes built on Kinsey Long's repeat-extraction benchmark and hidden-state cache; state-space formulation suggested by Ian Holmes.
